_baseline_note_plan_ladder: RE-RECORDED by the VyomQuant plan-ladder change. POST /api/billing/checkout gained two ADDITIVE response members and lost none: `interval` ("month" | "year") and `price_source` ("published" | "fx"). WHY `interval`: annual billing did not exist before this change — Stripe's recurring interval was the hardcoded literal "month" — so a checkout could not state which cycle it was buying and the response had no cycle to report. WHY `price_source`: the amount is now charged from the catalogue's PUBLISHED price for a currency it publishes (INR, USD) and FX-converted only for one it does not. Those are different kinds of figure — a commitment versus a rate-dependent estimate — and a caller rendering a price is entitled to know which it has. Previously every amount was an FX conversion of the USD base, which is why GET /api/billing/plans answered ~Rs865 for the plan published at Rs999. Nothing was removed, renamed or retyped: `checkoutUrl`, `checkout_url`, `provider`, `currency`, `amount`, `order_id`, `key_id` and `razorpay_key` are unchanged in name, type and meaning, so every existing client keeps working.
_baseline_note_razorpay_only_checkout: RAZORPAY-ONLY AUTHORISES this re-record: ONE of the two recorded `returns` variants is REMOVED and the surviving one is unchanged. POST /api/billing/checkout had two return statements, one per gateway. Stripe was removed from the product in full -- its webhook route, portal route, credential branch, cancel path and lifecycle layer are deleted, not disabled -- so its checkout branch went with it and the Razorpay variant (order_id, key_id, razorpay_key, amount, currency, interval, price_source, ...) is now the only one. NOTHING WAS REMOVED FROM A SURVIVING VARIANT: the diff reads 'key added' for order_id / key_id / razorpay_key only because the capture compares `returns` POSITIONALLY and the Razorpay entry has moved from index 1 to index 0. `currency` reads as 'computed -> str' for the same positional reason. A dormant second gateway is worse than no second gateway: it keeps a webhook route, a credential branch and an entitlement funnel alive that nobody exercises.
